about: Topic packs written by the scheduled routine. Every slug here, and every slug in ../topics.json, is taken: later runs must pick new topics from BACKLOG.md and pass check.mjs.

topics.title: Letting go of people-pleasing
topics.description: For learning to say no and stop shaping yourself around other people's approval.
topics.firstLine: People-pleasing usually started as a clever way to stay safe. Over the next ninety days you get to decide whether it still serves you.

topics.title: Changing careers
topics.description: For leaving one line of work and growing into the next.
topics.firstLine: Leaving one kind of work for another is a big move. It makes sense that part of you feels unsteady right now.

topics.title: Starting over in a new place
topics.description: For building a life, and a new sense of self, after a move.
topics.firstLine: Moving somewhere new takes more out of a person than most people admit. If you are tired in a way sleep does not fix, that makes sense.

topics.title: From putting off to doing
topics.description: For outgrowing procrastination and becoming someone who starts and finishes.
topics.firstLine: Putting things off is not a character flaw. It is usually a way of protecting yourself from a feeling you would rather not have.

topics.title: Quieting self-doubt
topics.description: For outgrowing a harsh inner critic and growing into quieter confidence.
topics.firstLine: The voice that tells you that you are not enough has been talking a long time. For the next few months, you get to talk back, gently.

topics.title: Becoming someone who moves
topics.description: For growing into a person who walks, stretches and exercises, at any age or fitness level.
topics.firstLine: You have spent years thinking of yourself as not the sporty type. This is a quiet invitation to try on a different story, one day at a time.
